'''Wolfgang Lippert''' (26 September 1937 in [[Nördlingen]]-20 June 2018) was a German botanist.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.pfeil-verlag.de/08oeko/e3_14r2.php |title=Biologische Vielfalt: Sammeln, Sammlungen und Systematik |website=www.pfeil-verlag.de |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160130094715/http://www.pfeil-verlag.de/08oeko/e3_14r2.php |archive-date=2016-01-30}} </ref> His main areas of interest are the [[Spermatophytes]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://trauer.sueddeutsche.de/traueranzeige/wolfgang-lippert|title=Gedenkseite von Wolfgang Lippert|website=trauer.sueddeutsche.de|accessdate=7 July 2018}}</ref>
